name: Lin
heading: Planning a China trip? Send me your dates or route.
body: I'm Lin — Chinese, lived abroad for years, and in China right now. Send me your dates or draft route and I'll reply within 48 hours with the 3 biggest route, timing or booking risks. Free. Human customized itinerary planning is a separate paid service.
paidServices: Licensed English-speaking guides — I can recommend some; you book and pay them directly
serviceNote: I only recommend guides; I don't take payment for guide or driver services.
note: Include your travel dates, cities and main questions. Please leave out passport numbers, payment details and other sensitive information.
homeTitle: China Trip Planning Help from a Local | ChinaEase Buddy
homeHeading: Plan your first China trip with local help.
homeDescription: Plan your first China trip with practical guides, a free itinerary preview and personal route-planning help from Lin. Check entry, transport, payments and arrival details.
digitalHeading: Premium Toolkit and Buddy AI travel passes
digitalScope: Trip Pass and Group Pass include the full Premium Toolkit, all premium phrase cards and extra Buddy AI messages for 14 days: your first 10 messages each day are free, and pass messages are used after that. One-time payment, no auto-renewal. Human customized itinerary planning is a separate paid service. Lin can recommend licensed English-speaking guides, whom you book and pay directly.
